hero.title: J.K.K. Munirajah College of Agricultural Science
hero.summary: JKKMCAS is a TNAU-affiliated agricultural college in the Erode region. Its published teaching material gives applicants a specific view of agronomy, soil science and farm-management study. The audited ICAR record covers its B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture programme for 2024–2029.

overview.heading: Crop and soil learning in the Erode region
paragraphs: J.K.K. Munirajah College of Agricultural Science is a TNAU-affiliated agriculture college in the Erode region. Institutional historical material dates its start to 2014, and a dated college invitation identifies its location at T.N. Palayam, Gobi.

The crop-management curriculum connects cultivation decisions with scientific analysis. Published subject areas include agronomy, soil science, microbiology, crop physiology and agricultural engineering. The course table provides concrete examples for prospective students, from practical crop production to rainfed agriculture and soil-fertility management. Applicants can use those topics to discuss their interests and request the current laboratory and fieldwork timetable.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The audited agriculture degree is supported by official crop-management course material covering agronomy, soil resource assessment, fertility management, water conservation and machinery subjects.

campus.heading: Practical crop management as a teaching focus
campus.intro: The official department description connects crop-management teaching to laboratory analysis and farm management. Its course table includes practical crop production in kharif and rabi seasons, rainfed agriculture and soil-fertility subjects.

facilities.name: Crop-management teaching
facilities.description: The official department page describes laboratory analysis and farm-management learning.

practical_learning: Published course titles include Practical Crop Production for kharif and rabi crops.
The curriculum material lists rainfed agriculture, watershed management and soil-and-water conservation.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: A current agriculture-specific scholarship schedule for JKKMCAS was not verified. Request the scheme name, funding authority, category rules, renewal conditions and net payable amount in writing before relying on a concession.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The official homepage lists career opportunities, but a current graduate-employment report was not verified. General sectors that agriculture graduates may enter should not be presented as this college’s placement record.

faqs.question: Why do sources use both Science and Sciences?
faqs.answer: The current official website uses College of Agricultural Science; the audited ICAR entry uses Agricultural Sciences. The profile preserves the official public-facing name and the exact register wording in recognition.

faqs.question: Where is JKKMCAS based?
faqs.answer: The dated 2024 college invitation lists T.N. Palayam, Gobi, Erode 638506.

faqs.question: Which university is it affiliated to?
faqs.answer: Both the official website excerpt and the ICAR audit identify Tamil Nadu Agricultural University.

faqs.question: What practical subjects can applicants inspect?
faqs.answer: The official crop-management course table includes practical crop production, rainfed agriculture and soil-fertility management.

faqs.question: Does the ICAR entry confirm this year’s admission seats?
faqs.answer: No. It records accreditation scope, including a printed intake, for 20 June 2024 to 19 June 2029. Ask for the current admission seat matrix.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for JKKMCAS?
faqs.answer: J.K.K. Munirajah College of Agricultural Science is recorded as established in 2014.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for JKKMCAS?
faqs.answer: https://jkkmcas.org/admissions. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact JKKMCAS?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: 04285 298080; Public email: deanjkkmcas@tnau.ac.in. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
